evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of recurrent palpitations in an 80-year-old man with
atrial fibrillation.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 85 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 190 ms, QRS 95 ms, QTc
416 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.
Most recent echo showed an ejection fraction of 30%.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPID PANEL
Total Cholesterol: 121 mg/dL
LDL Cholesterol: 74 mg/dL
HDL Cholesterol: 32 mg/dL (L)
Triglycerides: 79 mg/dL

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 138 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.0 mmol/L
Chloride: 99 mmol/L
CO2: 25 mmol/L
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL
Glucose: 104 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.1 mg/dL

Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by moutth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no carotid bruits.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: faint bibasilar crackles.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
